text: Humberside Avenue between High Park Avenue and Dundas Street West is a collector road and has a current speed limit of 40 km/h. Reducing the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h will provide consistency with the surrounding residential street that are 30 km/h.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40 kilometres per hour to 30 kilometres per hour on Humberside Avenue, between High Park Avenue and Dundas Street West.
